result.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, isInvalidEmail is set to true on client-side validation failure and only reset on the cancel button click; it is never cleared on successful re-validation or on mutation error/success. A user who triggers the banner and then corrects the emails will see the stale error banner persist alongside a successful/failed submit. The cancel button does reset it (`setIsInvalidEmail(false)`), so it is recoverable, making this a minor but real UI state defect introduced by the new code.

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` only on client-side validation failure (`handleAdd` else branch), but it is never reset when the user edits the emails or when a server-side mutation error occurs (`addGuestsMutation.onError` only shows a toast). It’s only cleared on Cancel. Therefore, after one invalid attempt, the red error banner can remain visible even after inputs are corrected and a subsequent submit fails server-side, matching the finding.
